heading: INT. COURTROOM - CONVERTED RIVER FERRY - DAY

units.text: INT. COURTROOM - CONVERTED RIVER FERRY - DAY
A courtroom bolted into the old car deck of a retired ferry.
Porthole windows.
Brass railings.
The floor rolls faintly with the current.
The gallery is empty save for gulls on the sills.
JUDGE FAIRWEATHER (70s, red robe, half-moon glasses) presides from a raised platform.
ROSAMUND (40s, prosecutor, charcoal suit) stands at the lectern with a stack of exhibits.
TIMOTHY (30s, defense counsel, rumpled tie) sits next to an empty chair.
BAILIFF DOYLE (50s, wide shoulders, mustache) leans by the door, bored.
The court will resume.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: Your Honor, the state calls its final witness.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: Objection.
units.name: TIMOTHY

units.text: Overruled, Mr. Timothy.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: It's Mr. Beasley, Your Honor. Timothy is my first name.
units.name: TIMOTHY

units.text: Sit down, Timothy.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: He sits.
Rosamund shuffles her papers, then sets them down.
The state calls the defendant's mother.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: She is not here.
units.name: TIMOTHY

units.text: She was subpoenaed.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: She went to the galley.
units.name: BAILIFF DOYLE

units.text: Bailiff, fetch her.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: He lumbers off.
The ferry lurches.
Papers slide across the table.
Timothy catches his water glass.
Rosamund catches the Judge's gavel.
They exchange a long look, and for a moment both of them smile, then they remember where they are.
Counsel, would you care to settle?
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: We're beyond that, Your Honor.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: We were beyond that at the first harbor.
units.name: TIMOTHY

units.text: Then the court is adjourned until we dock.
units.name: JUDGE FAIRWEATHER

units.text: The gavel falls.
A gull flaps off the sill.
In the galley, a faint cheer rises, and everyone in the courtroom pretends not to hear.
